Dual-battery system; 2.75 kg with batteries, 3.75 kg MTOW and 1 kg payload. Typical flight time is 30 minutes with payload.
Quickly interchangeable gimballed camera packages; customized sensor integration offered separately.
MAVLink-based mission planning supports automatic, semi-automatic and manual operation.

profiles.configuration: Battery-electric Commander 3 XL: current controller/radio options plus a separately dated 2022 physical specification. Not the Hybrid. Exact Cube variant, CPU, RAM and battery energy are unspecified.

facts.details: Cube autopilot with triple-redundant IMU; the product page does not name a Cube color/version or processor SKU.
Microhard PDDL, Herelink Blue, Doodle Labs Helix or DTC BluSDR. These are alternative configurations, not four simultaneously installed radios; exact frequency SKUs need configuration records.
Triple IMU; optional Gremsy VIO payload combines 4K zoom, 640×512 radiometric thermal imaging and a 2,400 m laser rangefinder.
2022 sheet specifies 55 lb MTOW, 29 lb including batteries, 22 lb payload and up to 50 minutes flight. Endurance depends on payload and conditions.
Quick-detach arms, retractable landing gear and universal payload mounting support interchangeable camera and delivery equipment.

profiles.configuration: September 2023 target specification, explicitly subject to change. No controller, compute, memory, radio or sensor BOM is established; battery-electric Commander 3 XL components are not inherited.

facts.details: Pegasus-powered Draganfuel Ignite 70 cc two-stroke, fuel-injected and liquid-cooled engine-generator; 4 kW maximum, 2–3.5 kW ideal output, 24–50 V.
25 kg MTOW, 4 kg maximum payload; advertised target endurance up to three hours. Generator base mass is 3.5 kg, not total aircraft mass.
Automatic throttle and self-starting engine with capacitive-discharge ignition. The sheet does not identify an external control bus.

profiles.configuration: Iris family architecture, not one universal payload. CPU, RAM, storage, radio hardware and propulsion/battery specifications are unpublished in these sources.

facts.details: Onboard laser positioning, obstacle detection and automatically controlled camera gimbal; external positioning beacons are not required.
Tablet starts the automated inspection flight; sensor payload differs by Iris variant.
Captured imagery passes to analysis software and maintenance reports; Donecle cloud stores inspection history and supports team access.
Iris GVI performs visual inspection; Iris dentCHECK uses a separate 3D measurement payload. Neither payload is assigned to every Iris.

profiles.configuration: GVI visual-inspection configuration. Processor, memory, battery and radio-module details remain unpublished.

facts.details: 24 MP camera, advertised 16 pixels/mm² inspection resolution; image-sensor manufacturer/model unspecified.
Iris laser-based localization operates without GPS or external beacons, with obstacle detection and automatic gimbal control.
Tablet-based mission launch; image analysis and report review remain separate workflow stages.
Inspection results enter Donecle’s analysis/reporting and cloud history platform.

profiles.configuration: 3D dent-measurement configuration, separate from GVI. CPU, memory, radio and power-system details remain unpublished.

facts.details: 8tree dentCHECK sensor measures surface dents and buckles; advertised depth accuracy 0.1 mm. This is not the GVI camera specification.
Iris laser localization and obstacle detection support automated scanning around the inspected structure.
Measurements support digitized dent maps and reports for specified aircraft surfaces; supported airframes and operational approval depend on configuration.

profiles.configuration: 557 MPA reference for the generic Robot 557 record; other 557 variants can differ. Automated concrete removal does not establish autonomous road navigation. CPU, memory and radio-chip identifiers are unpublished.

facts.details: ConjetONE control system, configurable through radio handset or onboard display; controller CPU unspecified.
Remote radio control; an optional wireless kit links robot and pump controls. Frequencies and protocols are not published.
18.7 kW diesel or three-phase electric supply: 380–480 V AC/32 A, alternatively 200 V AC/63 A, 50–60 Hz.
2,740 kg; tracks extend from 1,200 to 1,900 mm and main body slides 400 mm for stability. Multipurpose arm reaches 5.05 m vertically.
Hydrodemolition tool kits and high-pressure pumps; prepared for Conjet Connect, which is not proof that every robot has a connected subscription.

profiles.configuration: Second-generation survey AUV, using the 2024 manufacturer sheet and a direct CTO interview. Exact processor-board revision, memory, storage and radio modules remain unspecified; payload configurations differ.

facts.details: CEO/CTO Charles Chiau identifies NVIDIA Jetson TX2 as the primary GPU solution in the interviewed vehicle configuration.
Exail Phins 9 Compact INS, Nortek DVL500/DVL1000 Compact listed options, and u-blox ZED-F9P-02B L1/L2 GNSS.
NORBIT FLS-42 forward sonar; AML pressure and sound-velocity/temperature sensors. SonTek Castaway CTD is deployed from the support vessel, not onboard.
Configuration 1: NORBIT MBES-42, Starfish 454 and OFG magnetometer. Configuration 2: NORBIT SBP-42, Starfish 992 and OFG magnetometer. Sonar frequencies describe acoustic signals, not radio bands.
Iridium, Wi-Fi, ISM radios and acoustic communications; independent acoustic recovery tracker. Exact radio bands unspecified.
Swappable 3 kWh lithium-ion battery; 2.4 m, 60 kg, 300 m depth rating and 3-knot survey speed.
Onboard quality-control processing, Trident operational control and Mosaic survey-data platform; these cloud products do not imply a public live location feed.

profiles.configuration: February 2026 long-range multi-use PF4 specification. This is not PF4-CAT3. CPU, RAM, storage, modem SKU and battery voltage/chemistry are not disclosed in this release.

facts.details: 2.4 GHz link advertised to 4 km unobstructed, or LTE within coverage; multi-SIM is optional.
GPS plus QZSS, CLAS-compatible. Optional mission payloads include YellowScan Ultra 3+ LiDAR, VIO infrared/visible camera and CX-GB200 gimbal camera.
Four 20,000 mAh batteries; 12.1 kg airframe and 19.4 kg with batteries in logistics configuration. Maximum payload 5.5 kg; advertised endurance 70 minutes empty or 50 minutes loaded.
User-exchangeable payloads, hot-swap capability and remote controller. Electrical connector details are not given.

profiles.configuration: June 2024 logistics-aircraft development/type-certificate application specification, formerly JP2. An application is not a granted certificate. CPU, memory, radio, navigation sensors and battery remain undisclosed; PF4 multi-use specifications are not substituted.

facts.details: Approximately 2.3 × 2.5 × 0.6 m, 24.9 kg MTOW and 5 kg payload; development reference range approximately 35 km.
Cargo enters through the top of the aircraft and detaches from the bottom.

profiles.configuration: Historical 2013 Command architecture reference. Later kits and jurisdictions differ. CPU, RAM and radio-chip SKUs are undisclosed; these frequencies are not universal identifiers for all Cat machines.

facts.details: Dual GNSS receivers, object-detection sensors, machine-health and tire/payload monitoring. Specification lists 76.5 GHz radar and 64-beam rotating LiDAR.
Wireless exchange with MineStar and nearby machines; separately documented A-stop transmitter at 919 MHz. The latter is a historical configuration-specific frequency.
Display and onboard A-stop receiver accept 9–32 V DC; radar is rated 12 V, 1 A. These are electronics ratings, not vehicle propulsion power.
6.5-inch 640×480 touch display with four NTSC video inputs; GNSS receiver uses a 12-pin Deutsch connector and TNC antenna connection.
MineStar coordinates mapped autonomous operating areas, fleet assignments and diagnostics.

profiles.configuration: 793F host truck with Command compatibility. Host powertrain and historical Command architecture are separately sourced; sensor/radio revisions on any deployed truck require its configuration records. CPU and memory unpublished.

facts.details: Cat C175-16 diesel, rated 1,976 kW gross in this brochure, driving a six-speed mechanical powershift transmission; this is not the newer unsuffixed 793.
VIMS monitoring and service data interface support diagnostics; exact autonomous-kit connectors are unspecified.
Caterpillar explicitly lists the 793F among models supporting Command for hauling retrofit kits.
2013 architecture uses dual GNSS and obstacle sensors. This does not establish the sensor SKU installed on a later 793F.

profiles.configuration: 789D mining-truck host and documented Command retrofit compatibility, not the separate autonomous water-truck equipment package. Exact autonomous CPU, sensors, modem and memory are unpublished here.

facts.details: 3516C-HD diesel rated 1,566 kW gross, or optional 3516B EUI rated 1,417 kW. Engines are alternatives rather than interchangeable specifications.
Six forward powershift gears with mechanical final drives; payload and gross-weight limits depend on body/tire configuration.
VIMS machine monitoring and service connections; controller silicon not named.
Caterpillar lists 789D among trucks supporting Command for hauling retrofit kits. This establishes platform compatibility, not a universal sensor or radio BOM.

profiles.configuration: Current hardware reference; Devanthro reports several generations since 2023. Exact Orin variant, RAM, storage, battery capacity and radio-module identifiers are unspecified.

facts.details: NVIDIA Jetson Orin plus Orin Nano; the larger Orin module is not identified as AGX or NX.
4K fisheye RGB cameras, millimeter-wave radar and stereo microphones; sensor SKUs and radar frequency unspecified.
Differential-drive base; 60 kg, 1.65 m tall; advertised six-hour operation and self-docking.
QDD and Dynamixel actuators; two 6-DOF arms with 1.5 kg payload each, two-finger grippers and a 3-DOF neck.
ROS 2 middleware with human-in-the-loop VR telepresence and stereoscopic video. This configuration is not described as fully autonomous.

profiles.configuration: 2026 Mech platform and supplier-disclosed control architecture. The lower-level controller is separate from the AI computer; AI accelerator, installed memory/storage, radio and battery capacity remain unspecified.

facts.details: Beckhoff CX5240 with Intel Atom x5-E3940 handles motion and safety logic. It is not identified as the robot’s AI inference computer.
Beckhoff EP3751-0260 EtherCAT box supplies accelerometer and gyroscope measurements.
Up to sixteen cameras; arm torque control operates at 4 kHz. Camera SKUs are not disclosed.
Battery-powered rover with four steerable wheels and dual vacuum pumps; two Kawasaki-manufactured arms, HiWin motion components, 60 kg combined lift and 5.4 m armspan.
EtherCAT and CAN, PCB-mounted Beckhoff EJ-series I/O and TwinSAFE functional safety. Generic wireless EtherCAT capability does not establish an installed RF module.
Windows 10 IoT Enterprise on the CX5240; Dexterity Physical AI supplies higher-level decisions and can operate standalone or with cloud services.

profiles.configuration: DexR trailer-loading robot in Dexterity’s September 2023 announcement. This does not establish the later Mech hardware BOM; CPU, memory, radios, battery and camera SKUs are unpublished.

facts.details: Vision builds a 3D representation of boxes and trailer space; force control supplies contact feedback while packing.
Autonomous mobile base docks to a powered conveyor; two arms can pick and place boxes concurrently.
Integrated motion planning coordinates both arms; packing software updates the trailer model as boxes arrive and learns from completed placements.

profiles.configuration: October 2026 Developer/Pro manual configuration, offered as a dated reference for generic T800 records. It differs from the retail edition table; do not combine its NEZHA/Odin2/battery specifications with the retail Basic edition.

facts.details: Four-core NEZHA Robot PC, called NeZha N97 in the interface table, plus a twelve-core NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin AI PC.
Robot PC: 8 GB RAM and 64 GB storage. AI PC: 64 GB RAM and 256 GB SSD.
Odin2 head module integrates stereo RGB, LiDAR and IMU over Gigabit Ethernet; two SC132GS global-shutter image sensors and 940 nm optical ranging.
Torso IMU documentation lists Yesense YIS320-E11 UART / YIS320-E30 USB alternatives. Four microphones and two speakers; Pro adds five tactile sensors per hand.
Network diagram places Wi-Fi on the application computer; radio chipset and band are unspecified in this manual.
Removable ternary-lithium battery: 61.2 V, 20 Ah, 1.22 kWh; charged outside the robot. This is not evidence of the retail page’s advertised solid-state battery chemistry.
Developer: 25 DOF, approximately 84.5 kg. Pro: 29 body DOF plus fourteen hand DOF, approximately 85.3 kg; 1.73 m tall.
Both computers connect by Ethernet to an onboard router. External RJ45 plus separate USB-A 3.0 connections to the Orin and NEZHA computers.
Ubuntu on both computers; ROS 2 interfaces expose motion and sensor topics for authorized development.

profiles.configuration: Retail comparison read November 2026. These edition specifications differ from the October developer manual; no equivalence between its NEZHA controller and the retail eight-core CPU is established.

facts.details: Basic: Orin NX 16G. Open Source, Pro and Max: AGX Orin 64G, with Thor offered on request. All list an unnamed eight-core base CPU.
Basic: 16 GB; higher editions: 64 GB. Installed storage is not listed.
Basic lists an Intel binocular camera and no 3D LiDAR. Open Source, Pro and Max list binocular cameras plus LiDAR; sensor SKUs unspecified.
Wi-Fi 5 and Bluetooth 5.0 throughout; Max additionally lists 5G. These are shared standards, not unique robot identifiers.
Basic/Open Source: 25 DOF. Pro: 43 including hands. Max: 46 including hands and a three-axis waist.
Quick-removal lithium battery; capacity not established by the retail table.

profiles.configuration: Current SE01 product-page hardware reference. No exact CPU/GPU, RAM, radio, battery capacity or sensor part numbers are established; T800 components are not inherited.

facts.details: LiDAR, depth and infrared cameras; body diagram labels RGB-D, an IMU and high-precision force sensors.
Removable battery with power-management system; proprietary planetary, harmonic and linear joint actuators. The page’s ambiguous battery-capacity display is not used as a rating.
Gigabit Ethernet and USB 3.0; six-DOF dexterous hand with force feedback, plus two speakers.

profiles.configuration: 620 S G2 / TS4.2 manual configuration used as a qualified ARA reference. This is a tractor-mounted precision sprayer, not a self-driving tractor. Exact CPU/GPU, RAM, storage and modem parts remain unspecified.

facts.details: Six vision boxes each contain an image-processing computer, LED-control board and cooling fan; processor models are not named.
Each box has a target-recognition camera, four flash LEDs and a visual-odometry camera; a boom pressure sensor feeds one vision computer.
Router and switch in the main electrical box, with Wi-Fi and 4G antenna. Radio bands, MAC allocations and modem SKU are not established.
Two 12 V lead batteries in series provide 24 V; a PTO-driven 28 V alternator recharges them. Vision boxes have RTC backup batteries.
Three master vision boxes drive solenoid valves across three booms; remote on/off and boom-height controls.
156 Euspray OC1X502 nozzles, 152 effective with all three booms; 6.04 m effective spray width and 10 ms minimum valve opening.
Target recognition and visual odometry time nozzle activation to the machine’s forward motion.

profiles.configuration: Legacy H8E identified explicitly in Harris support documentation; not the newer HX8. Family-wide service guidance is qualified below. CPU, Cube revision, battery capacity, RAM and storage capacity are not established.

facts.details: H8E calibration instructions identify compass and IMU/accelerometer, with GPS checked before flight.

Support instructions form the Basic ID from 18136 + H8E + vehicle serial. This is a configured serial template, not a MAC address or proof of nearby reception.

profiles.configuration: Current FB3 cargo-platform reference. Flight controller, CPU, memory, radio chip/bands and battery voltage/capacity are unpublished. The page’s safety block names FB4, so its ADS-B/radar claims are not assigned to FB3.

facts.details: Eight propulsion units powered by four swappable lithium-ion battery packs; 70 kg empty mass and 100 kg maximum cargo.
RF plus 4G links are listed for the ground-control packages; exact air-interface protocols are not specified.
Essentials: seven-inch handheld GCS. Standard: ten-inch handheld GCS. Pro: three-screen mobile GCS. These are alternative kits.
Essentials includes a 7 kW single-phase charger; Standard/Pro include a 16 kW three-phase charger.
Air-and-ground Starlink C2 is offered for Standard and Pro kits, not Essentials.
Gimbal video in all three kits; additional FPV video in Pro. Camera models and resolutions unspecified.

profiles.configuration: G1 Quick Start Guide V2.0 in developer documentation 2.2.4. Component vendors beyond the compute module, installed storage and unique radio identifiers are not disclosed.

facts.details: NVIDIA AGX Orin, rated 275 TOPS.
64 GB; storage capacity unspecified.
2.4/5 GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 5.2; shared standards do not identify a particular robot.
One head stereo camera; four torso RGB cameras and two torso IMUs; two wrist depth cameras and two six-axis wrist force sensors.
One 3D LiDAR, eight ultrasonic sensors and one chassis IMU; two four-microphone arrays.
48 V / 30 Ah battery; 54.6 V / 10 A charging. Four-wheel omnidirectional base; advertised eight-hour runtime under laboratory conditions.
Two seven-axis arms, two-axis neck, three-axis waist and two leg axes; 5 kg per arm. Two USB 3.0 ports, HDMI and 5.5-inch touchscreen; wireless charging dock optional.
Galbot SDK 1.10.0 documents Python and C++ APIs; exact onboard OS revision is not established here.

64 GB; storage unspecified.
2.4/5 GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 5.2; wireless remote controller and emergency-stop accessory are listed.
Head stereo camera and 3D LiDAR; two wrist depth cameras; one chassis LiDAR and safety edge; one additional column LiDAR.
Two hot-swappable 48 V / 30 Ah packs; two-hour charging per pack. Four-wheel omnidirectional base, 1.5 m/s maximum; advertised eight-hour laboratory runtime.
Two seven-axis arms, two-axis neck and one lift axis; 15 kg payload per arm. Two USB 3.0 ports, Ethernet and seven-inch touchscreen.

profiles.configuration: Published T10 specification. Flight-computer silicon and onboard memory are unspecified. Ground-controller resources are explicitly separated from aircraft hardware.

RD2424R omnidirectional radar and RD2414U upward radar operate at 24.05–24.25 GHz. Front/rear FPV cameras provide 1280×720 video at 15–30 fps.
BAX501-9500mAh-51.8V flight pack; 9.5 Ah, 51.8 V. 84 KV motors with 100×10 mm stators and 33×9-inch propellers.
Eight-litre tank; four nozzles, with XR11001VS listed as standard.
RM500-ENT has 4 GB LPDDR4 and 32 GB storage, with microSD support up to 128 GB. These are not aircraft RAM/storage.
RM500-ENT: 5.5-inch 1080p display and HDMI 1.4; Wi-Fi a/g/n/ac and Bluetooth 4.2.
GNSS plus RTK using GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou and Galileo signals in the published RTK configuration.

profiles.configuration: T25P specification and April 2026 English manual. No exact onboard processor, RAM or storage is published; T25 components are not automatically assigned to T25P.

DB800 battery: 15.5 Ah, 52.22 V. Four 50-inch propellers, 59 KV motors with 100×28 mm stators and electronic speed controllers.
20 L spray tank, two LX07550SX sprinklers and two magnetic-drive impeller pumps; optional four-sprinkler setup. Spreading System 4.0 uses a 30 L tank and centrifugal disc.
OcuSync image-transmission antennas. Optional Enhanced Transmission combines that link with 4G using a separately installed cellular dongle/SIM; availability depends on service and region.
TKPL 2 controller with seven-inch 1920×1200 touchscreen and USB-C charging. D6000i is a ground charging generator, not an onboard engine.
DJI Agras provides mission/control functions; DJI Assistant 2 supports firmware servicing.

profiles.configuration: Current FlyCart 100 specification and English v1.0 manual. CPU, RAM and aircraft storage remain unspecified. Ground charging equipment is not onboard hybrid propulsion.

facts.details: Four arms with coaxial motor pairs; 62-inch propellers and 60 KV motors. Dual batteries supported; single-battery mode is for emergencies.
DB2160 or DB2212: each rated 41 Ah at 52 V. The two models are alternatives, not an instruction to mix them.
D-RTK antennas, LiDAR, front/downward radars, vision system and FPV camera. Exact sensor chips and radar frequency are not established.
2.400–2.4835 and 5.725–5.850 GHz; four antennas with 2T4R. 4G Enhanced Transmission is also listed; 1080p/30 fps live view.
A2EWH-100A flagship winch with up to 30 m cable, or A2EDL-100A dual-battery lifting system with 10 m cable. These are alternative cargo configurations.
TKPL2 controller with seven-inch display; Eport-Lite expansion requires the separately supplied PSDK cable combo.
DJI Delivery controls delivery missions.

LiDAR, radar, stereo cameras, wheel odometry, IMU and GPS; redundant braking systems.
GSM/EDGE/UMTS/LTE modem; V2X module is optional. No modem SKU, channel list or unique broadcast identifier is published.
LiFePO4 traction batteries; brochure mass specification uses four packs. Four-wheel steering; wireless charging optional. Battery capacity is not given in this source.
Automated access ramp, 29-inch interior display, passenger USB charging and communications with the supervision centre.
EZMaestro manages/supervises the fleet for scheduled routes or on-demand operation.

facts.details: NVIDIA identifies DRIVE AGX Orin in Gatik’s deployed fleet. Gatik’s March 2025 DRIVE AGX Thor announcement concerns its next-generation program; Thor is not assumed installed on every truck.
Cab-roof LiDAR, cameras and radar; side pods with LiDAR/cameras and rear camera/radar. The June guide does not provide a full sensor count or chip models.
Antennas provide positioning and two-way communication with Gatik infrastructure and remote supervisors. Protocols, bands and modem SKUs are unspecified.

20-, 26- or 30-foot cargo boxes; exterior sensor pods and automated-driving status indicators.

Temperature-controlled assembly line and precision ingredient dispensing; individual measurement sensors are not specified.
208 V outlet; manufacturer says no additional plumbing is required. Per-module current and motor specifications are not listed.
Touchscreen operation, programmable recipes and updateable software. These do not identify the controller processor or its operating system.

profiles.configuration: Kickmaker’s PAZZI Robotics integration account and current operator workflow. Historical prototype architecture is not a complete specification for every later restaurant. CPU, arm models, sensors, electrical ratings and wireless protocol are undisclosed.

facts.details: Operator describes dough pressing, sauce/topping application, cutting and serving, with kiosk or web ordering. Exact robot-arm and end-effector models are not identified.
Kickmaker documents a cloud-connected machine-learning platform coordinating robots and robotic modules. This names a system architecture, not an installed cloud server or radio chipset.

profiles.configuration: January 2024 manufacturer prospectus plus current One 150 system page. Payloads and links vary by customer; CPU, RAM, autopilot manufacturer and modem models are not established.

facts.details: The 2024 prospectus identifies an imported autopilot from Spain but gives no maker or CPU model; supplier country is not enough to assign a specific autopilot.
2024 prospectus specifies the manufacturer’s four-stroke Primoco Engine 340, replacing its earlier two-stroke Engine 500. Do not apply the new engine to every historical aircraft.
Manufacturer shows an Epsilon 180 EO/MWIR camera integration and offers other optical, LiDAR and radar payloads. These are configuration choices, not a standard all-sensor installation.
Manufacturer describes AES-256-protected communications and a direct GCS link; the 2024 prospectus identifies Norway as datalink source. RF band, waveform and terminal model remain unspecified.
Two operator roles—pilot and sensor operator—with vehicle-mounted or demountable GCS. A side-stick control revision was completed in 2023.

profiles.configuration: Full-body L7 manufacturer brochure. The separate L7-U upper body is excluded. Exact x86 CPU, Orin module SKU, RAM and radio components are not disclosed.

facts.details: Brochure lists 80 TOPS x86 compute plus 275 TOPS Orin compute. The performance figures alone do not establish an AGX Orin SKU or RAM capacity.
Binocular camera, 3D LiDAR and microphone array; individual sensor models are unspecified.
60 V, 15 Ah battery; 1.71 m tall, 65 kg excluding dexterous hands.
31 body degrees of freedom excluding hands, 55 including hands. XHAND1 five-finger hands have 12 active degrees of freedom each and direct-drive actuation.

profiles.configuration: Fifth-generation TALON, 2021 datasheet and TALON 5DOF table. CPU, RAM and battery capacity are unspecified; these component counts are not assigned to TALON VI.

facts.details: Persistent Systems MPU5 external IP-mesh radio and Gigabit Ethernet backbone; band/module selection is not established.

Gripper, elbow and rear cameras can use infrared-illuminated analog or IOP digital versions. Digital option is 2.1 MP, 1/3-inch CMOS, 720p. PTZ has 26× optical zoom; thermal/night-vision options are separate.
81 kg including batteries; quoted 3–4 hour operation depends on mission. Battery chemistry and capacity are not specified.
Two IOP-A, one IOP-B, four Gigabit Ethernet, two RS232, USB, CAN and six legacy interfaces. LCU laptop, TRC and UC-LITE controller choices; five-degree-of-freedom arm.
IOP and SAE JAUS AS4 architecture. Interface compatibility does not identify a unique over-the-air signature.

profiles.configuration: Current sixth-generation manufacturer product page. It does not provide a CPU, RAM, battery, camera SKU or exact port-count specification; earlier TALON values are not inherited.

facts.details: Manufacturer identifies MPU5 mesh networking. Actual RF module and band remain configuration-dependent.
Open input/output architecture supports additional cameras. Revised chassis is narrower with a longer-reach arm than earlier generations; numeric dimensions are not given here.
Autonomy and mapping support with IOP and SAE JAUS AS4 compliance.

profiles.configuration: Australian technical sheet QS_Vector_Technical_A4_AUS_Version_241115. This is a dated Vector configuration, not the later dual-processor Vector AI or the Trinity survey aircraft.

facts.details: NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16 GB is the listed AI/mission processor.
16 GB in the named Orin NX configuration; storage capacity is not published.
AES-256 encrypted IP mesh at 2.2–2.5 GHz. Dual S/C-band options are offered, without a C-band range in this sheet.
NextVision Raptor or Trillium HD40-LV; payload choice must be checked for the individual aircraft.
8.5 kg take-off weight, 2.8 m wingspan and IP54. Battery capacity and motor model are not identified.
Auterion Skynav or tactical laptop. Shared Vector/Scorpion fuselage, datalink and sensors support fixed-wing/multicopter conversion; this does not apply to Trinity.
QBase Tactical.

profiles.configuration: GmbH QS_VectorAI_Techsheet_250502, May 2025. Memory capacity, radio chipset and battery capacity are undisclosed. Earlier single-processor Vector specifications are not inherited.

facts.details: Two NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX processors, explicitly named on page 2.
2.2–2.5 and 4.4–4.9 GHz with AES-256 protection. ADS-B In is listed; ADS-B Out is optional, not proof that every aircraft broadcasts it.
NextVision Raptor EO/IR 360° payload option; precision landing and obstacle-awareness systems. Optional additional payloads are not assumed installed.
9.5 kg maximum take-off weight, 2.8 m wingspan and IP55. Motor and battery part numbers are not published.
USB-C Multiconnector and auxiliary payload bays.
ROS/Docker modular architecture and Receptor AI software suite.

profiles.configuration: SP 2.0 column in manufacturer brochure B253e0524. Earlier SP revisions and the CXT/XT are separate configurations. CPU, RAM, battery capacity and radio part numbers are not disclosed.

facts.details: PATH A-kit provides the control/autonomy subsystem; no processor SKU is identified.
PATH integrates LiDAR, radar and cameras. The brochure does not identify individual sensor models or a fixed payload fit.
Electric drive and lithium-ion batteries; hybrid engine/external generator are options. SP 2.0 table gives 1,134 kg and 3.05 × 1.52 × 1.02 m. XT diesel/AGM components are not assigned to SP.
Drive-by-wire integration and modular payload mounting; tablet, single-hand controller, smartwatch and soldier-system control options.
PATH sensor fusion, mapping and navigation with an upgradeable open architecture. Exact operating system is not disclosed.

profiles.configuration: Promobot C2 user manual dated October 2024. Stationary humanoid with transport wheels; not a walking biped. CPU, RAM and Wi-Fi module model are not disclosed.

facts.details: 1920×1080 camera up to 30 fps with RGB illumination; omnidirectional microphone and two speakers.
802.11n Wi-Fi at 2.4 or 5 GHz and RJ45 Ethernet. These common interfaces are not unique passive identifiers.
110/230 V AC, 50–60 Hz, maximum 700 W; robot up to 100 kg. Transport wheels move the fixed platform.
10.1-inch TFT IPS touchscreen, 1280×800; HDMI, USB and 12 V XLR display supply.
Manual lists head/arms/torso motion separately from servo counts: 17 head, three neck, three torso and 13 servos per arm.
Linguistic database and analytics services, with cloud synchronization or local-server configuration. SIP telephony and telepresence are optional.

profiles.configuration: NVIDIA 2021 computing account and Recycleye/FANUC 2024 integration account. These references do not establish the exact Jetson SKU, RAM, arm variant or network hardware for every current installation.

facts.details: Supplier identifies Jetson edge computing, with onsite inference. Exact processor module is unspecified.
Recycleye AI vision identifies material on the belt; camera model is not disclosed.
Six-axis FANUC LR Mate and iRPickTool visual line tracking. The source does not identify a specific LR Mate model suffix or controller.
DeepStream and TAO tools; GPU-enabled Azure cloud model training, deployed edge models, software updates and cloud log/dashboard processing. Azure servers are not onboard robot components.

profiles.configuration: Current Recycleye Robotics product page. No exact processor, RAM, camera or arm SKU is disclosed; the older documented Jetson implementation is not automatically assigned to QualiBot.

facts.details: Computer vision identifies waste items for sorting; sensor model is unpublished.
FANUC-co-developed arm with suction gripper and pneumatic panel. The page does not establish an exact FANUC model.

profiles.configuration: Universal Robots case study, two-UR20 installation. Earlier UR10e work is mentioned separately. CPU, RAM, battery capacity and wireless protocol are not disclosed.

facts.details: UR20 control boxes are integrated into the mobile system; the case study does not identify their processor model.
Two UR20 arms on a mobile robot base. IP65 applies to the UR20 arms, not a demonstrated rating for the entire platform.
Works with total stations; system records bracket alignment and fastener torque. Total-station and torque-sensor models are unspecified.
UR arms connect directly to the mobile system’s DC battery supply; voltage and energy capacity are not given.
Software produces position/alignment and torque logs for as-built verification.

profiles.configuration: Current S2 manufacturer specifications. CPU SKU, RAM, cellular modem, UWB chipset and motor models are not disclosed. Smart Cover is the separate vehicle-side interface.

facts.details: Industrial-grade computer runs Rocsys software and remote-monitoring functions; seven-axis motor-control architecture.
In-house IP67 camera with heating, angled protective glass and backlighting; vision estimates socket pose in six degrees of freedom.
Wired and 4G options. Smart Cover supports UWB vehicle-to-charging-robot communication; band and chipset are not specified.
Single-phase 110–240 V AC, under 10 A; approximately 250 kg. This is robot input power, not the EV charger’s output rating.
Electromagnetic locking and compliant suspension; API/web interface. S2-H adds environmental/protective and visibility equipment.
Remote monitoring and over-the-air software updates; manufacturer says operation can continue without network connectivity.

profiles.configuration: 300 m Falcon in Saab brochure REV19.3, copyright 2024. DR and customer payload installations are separate. CPU SKU, RAM and camera model are not disclosed.

facts.details: iCON assigns a microprocessor to each vehicle device. Introduced for new Falcons in 2017 and offered as an upgrade; older vehicles are not assumed upgraded.
One video channel via shielded twisted pair or fibre optic tether. This is a wired underwater link, not Wi-Fi.
Colour camera, heading/depth navigation pod and two LED lights. DVL and acoustic tracking equipment are optional.
Four horizontal and one vertical S1-MCT01 thrusters; surface 110/230 V AC single-phase, 50/60 Hz supply. 60 kg vehicle, 300 m depth rating; no onboard propulsion battery listed.
22-inch detachable touchscreen, USB hand controller and serial data connections. One- or five-function manipulators are options.
Auto-heading and auto-depth standard. Auto-altitude and station keeping optional; station keeping needs DVL and its interface.

profiles.configuration: 1,000 m Falcon DR column of REV19.3. Do not apply its mass, tether or depth rating to the 300 m Falcon. Processor SKU and RAM are unpublished.

facts.details: iCON vehicle control architecture.
Two video channels over fibre optic only.
Five S1-MCT01 thrusters; 110/230 V AC surface supply. 100 kg vehicle, 1,000 m depth rating and 15 kg payload.
One- or five-function manipulator options.

profiles.configuration: Manufacturer account of CSIRO’s particular Falcon installation, 2018. Named equipment is a customer configuration, not standard fit on every Falcon.

facts.details: Tritech Super SeaPrince sonar and Kongsberg OE14-502 HD zoom camera are identified for the CSIRO vehicle.

profiles.configuration: Third-generation platform announced October 16, 2024, with manufacturing started and deployment planned for 2025. Exact Orin SKU, RAM, radio hardware and battery capacity are not disclosed.

facts.details: NVIDIA Jetson Orin; the announcement does not identify NX versus AGX or a memory configuration.
Ouster REV7 digital lidar. REV7 names a hardware generation, not proof of a specific OS-series sensor model.
Battery-powered drivetrain with suspension. The announcement gives relative endurance improvements, not battery voltage or capacity.
Fail-safe mechanical braking with enhanced emergency stopping; enlarged enclosed cargo bin.
Onboard navigation and collision avoidance using Serve’s updated AI architecture.

profiles.configuration: Current manufacturer specification explicitly marked mk3. Processor, RAM, modem model and battery capacity are undisclosed. Runtime/charging values follow the specification table.

facts.details: 4G LTE; bands and modem SKU are not stated.
Proprietary SQ 3D LiDAR; four directional cameras for surrounding views, LED illumination, microphone and speaker.
Lithium-ion battery, 5–6 hours per charge, maximum 1.5-hour charging. 65 kg; 520 × 600 × 1,215 mm. Automatic return to charging station.
Pseudo rocker-bogie wheel mechanism and elevator integration. Front/rear text displays are optional.
Autonomous patrol, remote video and voice communication, recording and remote operation.

profiles.configuration: AWS supplier account dated March 1, 2023. Describes SQ-2’s deployed communications/software architecture; no CPU, RAM or exact hardware revision is established.

facts.details: 4G internet connection for telemetry and video; robot can continue autonomous operation when disconnected.
Proprietary 3D LiDAR, high-resolution camera and three fisheye views, microphones and speakers.
Golang connectivity software uses AWS IoT Core for telemetry and remote commands. The account does not specify a unique over-the-air fingerprint.

Patrol results go to Amazon RDS, current state to ElastiCache for Redis, position history to Timestream, and video to Kinesis Video Streams. These are cloud services, not onboard processors or storage.

profiles.configuration: Manufacturer retrofit architecture and support documentation. The host tractor determines propulsion; CPU, RAM, wireless module and sensor SKUs are not published here.

facts.details: Control unit connects to tractor steering and power systems and executes mission/path instructions.
GNSS unit, antennas and obstacle sensors connect to the controller. Support documentation identifies four cameras with computer-vision models.
Ethernet, camera and wireless communication connections are covered by maintenance guidance. Handheld kill switch and onboard/remote emergency stops are part of the system.
Vehicle OS (vOS), Vehicle Path Finding Module (vPFM) and mobile/desktop Vehicle Mission Control (vMC) for field planning, monitoring and alerts.

profiles.configuration: Current manufacturer page and May 2026 edge-computing account. Older ROAMEO brochure specifications are not merged into this configuration. Jetson SKU, RAM, modem and battery capacity are undisclosed.

facts.details: Manufacturer explicitly includes ROAMEO among products shipping with NVIDIA Jetson onboard; it does not identify the specific module.
Five solid-state 3D LiDAR sensors, cameras, GPS and IMU. Individual sensor models are not listed.
Built-in cellular carries encrypted video, audio and alerts to RADSOC/cloud services; modem and bands are not identified.
Battery-powered wheeled platform with automatic docking on schedule or battery threshold; current page quotes up to 16 hours per charge.
RADSOC/mobile interfaces expose video, location, route and battery state, with role-based access and logged actions.
SARA Edge runs onboard. A separate SARA Agent licence adds escalation/talk-down functionality.

profiles.configuration: Savioke’s August 2015 manufacturer announcement, hosted by RoboticsTomorrow. Describes the demonstrated fleet; CPU, RAM and exact camera SKU are not stated.

facts.details: Demonstration Relay fleet used Intel RealSense cameras. The release does not name R200 or another specific model.
Relay ran ROS and Savioke’s RealSense ROS wrapper, supporting onboard environmental sensing.

profiles.configuration: Intel CES 2016 backgrounder describes future Relay versions. This is an announced component plan, not verification of every shipped Relay or the 2015 demonstration fleet.

facts.details: Planned sixth-generation Intel Core i7; exact SKU, board and RAM are unspecified. The Intel NUC mentioned for AscTec NEO in the same document is not assigned to Relay.
Planned Intel RealSense R200 integration; installation status is not established by this announcement.

profiles.configuration: Sixth-generation Phoenix announcement. CPU, RAM, radio hardware and battery specifications are not disclosed; later generations are separate profiles.

facts.details: Proprietary haptic technology in the dexterous hands provides touch feedback.
Manufacturer gives 5 ft 7 in height, 155 lb mass and 55 lb maximum payload. Articulated robotic hands support fine manipulation.
Carbon software translates language instructions into robot actions and uses simulation for training.

profiles.configuration: Seventh-generation announcement. Earlier mass/payload numbers and later hand joint counts are not inherited. Processor and memory part numbers are undisclosed.

facts.details: Revised visual and tactile sensing for training-data capture; individual sensor models are not named.
Miniaturized hydraulics and revised hands, wrists and elbows improve range of motion and hand durability.
Carbon AI control software uses captured behavioural data; no onboard operating-system or accelerator SKU is identified.

profiles.configuration: Eighth-generation manufacturer announcement. This configuration has a wheeled base. No processor, RAM, radio module, battery specification or sensor part number is provided.

facts.details: Updated depth and vision cameras, wider field of view and higher resolution, plus revised audio/video sensing. Numeric resolutions are not disclosed.
Humanoid upper body on a wheeled base for supported manipulation; not a verified bipedal configuration.
Revised telemetry for collecting training data and robot interaction; transport protocol is not stated.

profiles.configuration: Aircraft and paired-control interface. The Snapdragon specifications on the manufacturer page belong to the separate TAC ground controller; aircraft CPU/RAM are undisclosed.

facts.details: MAVLink-compliant flight controller; processor SKU unspecified.
FLIR Hadron 640R combines 16 MP colour imaging and Boson 640 radiometric thermal imaging on a two-axis gimbal.
MicroSD recording; RAM capacity unspecified.
DHS documents the 2.4 GHz package; manufacturer specifies AES-256 downlink encryption.
DHS identifies a 22.2 V, 60 Wh lithium-ion Teal Performance Battery Pack, approximately 0.84 lb. Aircraft mass 2.75 lb; quoted maximum flight time 30 minutes.
TAC ground station with Teal QGC, Tomahawk Robotics Kinesis and ATAK UAS Tool support.

profiles.configuration: Ground controller, not the Teal 2 aircraft processor. Values follow the manufacturer’s TAC section.

facts.details: Qualcomm Snapdragon 845: octa-core Kryo 385 CPU, Adreno 630 GPU and Spectra 280 image processor.
6 GB LPDDR4X.
720p, approximately 300 ms latency and AES-256 encryption.
Manufacturer quotes six hours; capacity undisclosed.
Android.

profiles.configuration: Current Ocellus configuration; AiN navigation options are not assumed installed. RAM is undisclosed.

facts.details: RB5 platform with eight Kryo 585 CPU cores and Adreno 650 GPU.
Three-axis gimbal: FLIR Boson 640 R+, 35 mm 12 MP telephoto and 8 mm 16 MP wide-angle cameras.
Doodle hex-band radio; a shared radio family is not a unique aircraft identifier.
1.93 kg; preliminary 40-minute endurance estimate with Ocellus 3CP, pending final testing.
Replaceable arms and payloads; civilian GNSS and dual-band L1/L2 options.
FLIR Prism AI; Reveal Farsight, Athena AI and Palantir VNAV are optional.

profiles.configuration: Controller specifications; do not assign its interfaces or endurance to the aircraft.

facts.details: AES-256; M1–M6, 1625–2510 MHz, channel/band hopping.
220 Wh; quoted 12-hour runtime.
Nett Warrior backhaul, USB-C power output and HDMI video output.
Android with ATAK UAS Tool and QGC.

profiles.configuration: Skydio 2 column, 2023 operator manual pages 49–51. Separate from 2+ and from regulatory controller/radio records.

facts.details: NVIDIA Tegra X2: 256-core Pascal GPU, dual Denver 2 and quad ARM Cortex-A57 CPUs.
Qualcomm QCS605 with Adreno 615, octa-core Kryo 300 and Hexagon 685 DSP (two HVX units).
4 GB 128-bit LPDDR4 for autonomy; removable U3/V30 microSD for imagery.
2.4–2.483, 5.18–5.24 and 5.725–5.85 GHz. Standard Wi-Fi widths 20/40/80 MHz; Skydio Link 5/10 MHz.
Sony IMX577 12.3 MP main sensor; six Sony 1/3-inch 4K colour navigation cameras, f/1.8 and 200° field of view. GPS/GLONASS.
775 g with battery; nominal 23-minute flight time. Battery capacity is not specified in these tables.
Omnidirectional obstacle avoidance using top/bottom trinocular camera groups.

profiles.configuration: Current technical page. Its 70 Wh battery differs from the 2025 brochure’s 86.4 Wh pack; configurations remain separate. RAM/modem SKU unspecified.

facts.details: Qualcomm Snapdragon 865 SoC.
Encrypted internal storage; capacity not disclosed.
Wi-Fi 6 at 2400–2483.5 and 5150–5850 MHz; LTE/5G frequency ranges listed as 600–960 and 1700–2200 MHz. AES-256 for SL and AES-128 for 5G.
1-inch 12.5 MP main camera; two forward Samsung 1/2.8-inch 32 MP stereo cameras, 200° field of view. NightSense forward visible illumination.
4900 mAh, 14.4 V, 70 Wh lithium-ion. 785 g aircraft, nominal 20-minute flight and three-hour perch time.
Wired pairing with the controller.

profiles.configuration: 2025 brochure configuration. Its battery figures must not be substituted into the current technical-page profile.

facts.details: Qualcomm Snapdragon 865 SoC.
6000 mAh, 14.4 V, 86.4 Wh rechargeable lithium-ion; nominal 20-minute flight time.
1-inch 12.5 MP sensor, f/1.95 and 93° diagonal field of view.
Connect SL Wi-Fi 6 and Connect 5G LTE/5G; bands not listed in this brochure.

profiles.configuration: May 2020 manufacturer parts guide. Part numbers identify service assemblies, not necessarily processor or sensor silicon. CPU/RAM unspecified.

facts.details: AMR BCM controller assembly, Tennant part 1248248.
2D camera 1240062; front IFM O3D 3D assembly 1240059; left/right IFM O3X 3D cameras 1240239/1240632.
TiM551 LiDAR assembly 1240525; horizontal LiDAR assembly 1240234, model unspecified.
Telemetry controller 1243815 and antenna 1243814. No supported band or modem SKU is established by this parts list.
Touch LCD 1240639; separate upper, lower and power harnesses and AMR service cable.

profiles.configuration: T7AMR column of the 2022 joint T380AMR/T7AMR specification. Do not copy T380AMR figures or newer runtime claims into this revision.

facts.details: 24 V, 360 Ah system: four lithium-ion or four flooded lead-acid batteries. Listed runtime six/four hours respectively; offboard 24 V, 41.3 A charger, 100–240 V AC input.
650 mm disk cleaning path at 225 rpm; 110 L solution and recovery tanks. Maximum down-pressure 86 kg.
BrainOS supports teach-and-repeat and area-fill operation through the LCD touchscreen.

profiles.configuration: Schilling GEMINI REV4 sensor configuration (2021), with 2023 manufacturer hydraulic-system documentation. CPU, RAM and electronics-board SKUs are undisclosed.

facts.details: Valeport miniIPS depth sensor, iXblue Octans Nano motion reference unit and Teledyne RDI Pioneer 600 kHz DVL. The DVL is acoustic, not an RF transmitter.
Two six-degree-of-freedom manipulators with force-sensing wrists and integrated machine-vision cameras and lights.
H.264 RTSP video over Ethernet; up to four HD streams to a surface PC. This is tethered communication, not a Wi-Fi signature.
Seven Schilling thrusters, 250 hp hydraulic power unit and 150 hp auxiliary ISOL8 eight-cylinder pump.
100 Mb Ethernet through the arm and 120 W tool power; topside HDMI/NTSC/PAL video outputs.
StationKeep V2 control.

profiles.configuration: 2017 autonomy retrofit architecture. Host-vessel propulsion is separate; Siemens processor models and RAM are not stated.

facts.details: Marine industrial Siemens components and computers inside an IP67 electrical enclosure.
Integrates DGPS, AIS and radar data from vessel instruments; individual sensor manufacturers are unspecified.
Joystick remote control quoted at one kilometre. Radio bands/hardware are unspecified.
Interfaces with vessel propulsion, auxiliary equipment and onboard payloads.
Operator interface supports waypoint/grid navigation, multi-vessel command and collision-avoidance functions.

profiles.configuration: SM200 remote-control system, 2019/2022 manufacturer accounts. SM300 autonomous navigation and Siemens components are not automatically assigned to SM200.

facts.details: Line-of-sight wireless helm and propulsion control, quoted up to 1,000 m; protocol and chipset undisclosed.
Wearable control unit operates helm, propulsion, auxiliaries and payload equipment.
Remote joystick control. The 2019 account assigns autonomous operation specifically to SM300.

profiles.configuration: Current heavy-fuel aircraft specification. Payloads are selectable; they are not all installed on every aircraft. CPU, RAM and radio-band details are unpublished here.

facts.details: MPU5 or C-band radio configurations; SATCOM provides an additional beyond-line-of-sight option. No unique passive fingerprint is established.
Hoodtech 11/9/6-series imaging, ViDAR or SAR; anti-jam GNSS and M-code options. ADS-B Out is a listed option, not a universal broadcast.
JP5 heavy-fuel engine with ducted fan; 75 kg maximum gross takeoff mass, 3.8 m wingspan. 600 W available for payloads.
Mission-dependent payload installation; imaging and navigation equipment must be identified per configuration.
2025 block-upgrade announcement describes a Hivemind Pilot-ready configuration; that announcement alone does not prove every existing V-BAT has the upgrade.

profiles.configuration: May 30, 2022 manufacturer specification. Onboard CPU/RAM and radio operating band are not disclosed. Accessory sensors are separate options.

facts.details: Persistent Systems MPU5 using Wave Relay MANET; shared radio equipment does not uniquely identify a PackBot.
Three HD cameras, two-way audio and laser range finder. LWIR thermal camera and CBRN payloads are optional.
Two BB-2590 batteries for up to four hours or four for up to eight hours. Optional in-situ charging. 26.3 kg without batteries; zero-radius tracked turn.
uPoint touchscreen tablet with optional hand controllers; accessory ports. Arm lifts 20 kg close-in or 5 kg at 1.87 m extension.

profiles.configuration: June 29, 2022 manufacturer specification. CPU/RAM, battery capacity and radio make/band are not disclosed.

facts.details: Radio quoted at 800 m line-of-sight or 150 m non-line-of-sight; 200 m fibre-tether option.
Visible, near-infrared and long-wave infrared camera suite. MultiRAE Pro, JCAD, FIDO XT, Radiac and FirstDefender RMX are compatible sensor payloads, not universal fit.
Tracked, zero-radius turn; manufacturer quotes up to eight hours and mass below 164 lb. Battery details are unspecified.
MOCU3 rugged laptop and hand controller. Five-degree-of-freedom arm, 75.5-inch vertical reach; IOP-compliant expansion.

profiles.configuration: 2022 manufacturer family description, not one uniform hardware build. CPU, RAM, radio, battery and individual sensor SKUs remain unspecified.

facts.details: Cameras and LiDAR combined with 3D computer vision and machine-learning models.
Fleet Central enterprise software coordinates the Palion fleet. The account includes Tow Tractor and Lift variants; their mechanical specifications are not interchangeable.

profiles.configuration: AAIB-documented G-TEKV configuration, manufactured in 2019 and examined in 2023. This individual aircraft does not establish universal AR5 fit. CPU/RAM unspecified.

facts.details: Two 3W two-stroke engines; system description gives 170 cc boxer engines. Airframe maximum takeoff mass 180 kg; this aircraft’s authorization limited it to 165 kg.
Six links, including primary/backup radio-line-of-sight, 4G and satellite links. Primary SATCOM carries command, telemetry and video; backup prioritizes command. Radio frequencies are not disclosed.
Mode S ADS-B transponder fitted to this aircraft. This does not establish ADS-B on every AR5.
Separate crewed station controls the aircraft and payload.
Automatic return-to-home and landing capability documented by AAIB.

profiles.configuration: Manufacturer brochure contains Patrol and Deep Find configurations. Named payloads and navigation modules are selectable configurations, not universal fit. CPU/RAM unspecified.

facts.details: Custom autopilot; silicon model unpublished. Optional visual-based navigation module.
Deep Find lists IMSAR NSP-7/NSP-5 radar and Hoodtech AC14 imaging. Other listed options include AIS, EPIRB and EO/IR gimbals.
Radio-line-of-sight and SATCOM; Link-16 integration is listed for Deep Find. Frequencies/modem models unspecified.
Twin-engine aircraft, 180 kg maximum takeoff mass and 50 kg payload capacity. Brochure quotes 16–20 hours depending on payload.
Modular payload and datalink integration; automatic runway takeoff and landing.

profiles.configuration: Legacy SeaBotix manufacturer sheet, specification-page footer 13-4009 REV B, preserved by distributor Deeptech. Not the later vLBV300II specification. CPU/RAM undisclosed.

facts.details: 650-line colour camera, NTSC/PAL, 180° tilt; 2,160-lumen LED illumination. Sonar, USBL and HD/rear cameras are optional.
Six direct-drive brushless DC thrusters: four vectored, two vertical. Surface control system requires 3,000 W, 100–240 V AC. Vehicle mass 18.1 kg; depth rating 300 m.
Standard 250 m, 8.9 mm tether; optional lengths to 2,000 m. This is a wired underwater link, not a Wi-Fi signature.
Weatherproof colour LCD and removable controls in a rugged case; slip-ring tether reel.
Depth, heading and trim functions with video telemetry overlay.
Teledyne announced vLBV discontinuation in March 2025; service and parts depend on availability.

profiles.configuration: Current manufacturer M5 specifications. M3, A3 and M1 columns are separate vehicles. CPU, RAM, battery capacity and radio SKU unspecified.

facts.details: Diesel/hybrid-electric drivetrain. M5 specification lists 21,000 lb gross weight and speed above 25 mph.
M5 dimensions 234 × 105 inches; 60-inch deck height and 8,000 lb payload capacity. Field-modular payload installation.

profiles.configuration: FLIR’s October 2020 M5 integration account. Deployable robots are accessories, not onboard processors. CPU/RAM and radio-band specifications unpublished.

facts.details: Onboard processing stitches images from SUMIT360 multispectral modules; processor model unspecified.
SUMIT360 surrounds the vehicle with multispectral imaging. TacFLIR 280-HD gimbal combines high-definition optics and inertial navigation.
R80D SkyRaider aerial accessory supports tethered/untethered use; deployable FLIR SUGV provides a separate ground-robot view.

profiles.configuration: Current manufacturer configuration. CPU/RAM, modem and sensor silicon are unspecified. Published runtime figures use differing conditions, so no single runtime is inferred.

facts.details: 3D LiDAR, GNSS and odometry feed sensor fusion. Internet-connected 360° camera view supports remote assistance.
34 kWh lithium-ion/LiFePO battery; 2,300 kg empty mass. Airknife cleaning and 1.2 m³ hopper.
Radio controller for route teaching. Band, protocol and modem SKU are not disclosed.
Optional automatic debris-emptying/washing station or manual servicing ramp.
Cloud mission scheduling, remote assistance and diagnostic monitoring; local navigation uses the onboard sensor-fusion system.

profiles.configuration: March 2025 production-platform announcement, following closed-course validation, with scaled market entry targeted for 2027. Not proof that all earlier test trucks use this hardware.

facts.details: Flex Jupiter multi-chip compute architecture using NVIDIA DRIVE AGX and DRIVE Orin SoCs. DRIVE Thor is a future upgrade direction, not installed hardware established here.
LiDAR, radar and cameras; manufacturers and quantities undisclosed.

profiles.configuration: Current commercial software and operator interfaces, separate from the dated arm reference. No processor, radio, electrical or mechanical revision is inferred from an app or payment integration.

facts.details: QR-based mobile ordering uses Stripe; an iPadOS point-of-sale app integrates Square payment devices.
Web tools manage orders, pricing and inventory; analytics export data, remote controls assist staff, and mobile controls support cleaning and restocking.

profiles.configuration: June 2018 original interview with CEO/cofounder Scott Peters. Describes the scaffold-mounted masonry system, not a freestanding mobile robot. Processor, memory, radio, motor and generator models are not given.

facts.details: A laser climbs a story pole and finds markers; its measurements correct the brick-placement position.
Self-contained unit carries a generator and electrical cabinet; output ratings are not disclosed.
Motorized carriage runs on tracks attached to mast-climbing scaffolding. A conveyor and manual chutes feed bricks to a gripper; mortar mixing and dispensing accompany placement.
Software requests special bricks through designated chutes; the described configuration favors long, straight walls.

profiles.configuration: March 2021 installation commissioned by Goldacres. Attachment controller and cameras belong to the trailing sprayer, not every SwarmBot. Main autonomy CPU, RAM, GNSS receiver and RF hardware undisclosed.

facts.details: Goldacres attachment uses a Raven controller and Raven Control Module (RCM); this does not identify the vehicle autonomy processor.
Six Weedetect cameras, spaced three metres apart, support green-on-green or green-on-brown detection.
Four-cylinder Hatz diesel rated 83 hp; hydraulic drive with articulated steering and speed limited to 10 km/h.
Custom 2,500 L trailing sprayer with an 18 m boom and 16 controlled sections; spot or blanket spraying.

profiles.configuration: January 2025 Croplands integration, separate from the 2021 Goldacres installation and later Series 2 options. Processor, memory, radio and power components not established by this source.

facts.details: Articulated carrier on 3 m wheel centres tows a suspended-gooseneck Pinto with 3,000 L tank and 18 m or 24 m boom.
WEED-IT optical weed detection controls targeted spraying on this attachment.

profiles.configuration: August 2026 supplier announcement. AutoFill and six-wheel drive are options, not equipment on every SwarmBot. Main CPU, RAM, radio and engine variant are not identified.

facts.details: Pinto 3,000 L sprayer; optional AutoFill hopper connects to a farm filling station for automatic refilling.
Six-wheel drive is an optional configuration for challenging terrain.
WEED-IT spot-spraying sensing on the autonomous SwarmFarm platform.

profiles.configuration: Manufacturer CM42 specification. Fixed camera already represented in the catalog; not a robot. Storage is SKU-dependent. RAM and any onboard radio are not established; the separate gateway does not prove camera Wi-Fi.

facts.details: Ambarella CV25S88.
microSD/SDXC configurations from 256 GB to 2 TB; RAM not listed.
5 MP 1/2.8-inch progressive CMOS, fixed 2.8 mm f/1.6 lens, IR-cut filter, infrared illumination and built-in microphone.
IEEE 802.3af Type 1; 37–57 V. Published draw: 6.1 W with IR, 3.2 W without.
RJ45 10/100/1000 Ethernet and PoE. RTSP 1.0 supports two concurrent streams with audio.
H.264/H.265 recording, adaptive quality and configurable cloud backup; people/vehicle search, motion alerts and privacy regions.

profiles.configuration: Outdoor Wi-Fi gateway specification. Distinct from GC31-E cellular gateway. CPU, memory, RF chipset and Bluetooth version are not disclosed. Directional antenna and power accessories are separate options.

facts.details: 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax; single radio selects 2.4 or 5 GHz. 2×2 DL MU-MIMO, two external N-type omnidirectional antennas, AP/client modes. Bluetooth supports iOS Command setup.
Three Gigabit RJ45 ports: two LAN and one configurable WAN/LAN. Local management page uses Ethernet; Command management requires WAN.
54 V barrel input, 12–36 V terminal block, or 90 W 802.3bt Type 4 PoE input. Two PoE++ outputs share a 60 W budget. Gateway alone draws 9 W above −25°C or 19 W below.
WPA2/3 PSK and Enterprise username/password authentication; Command monitoring and remote power cycling. Perpetual PoE keeps downstream devices powered during gateway restart.

profiles.configuration: H-8 configuration shown under the broader DriX family entry. H-9 and O-16 specifications must not inherit these dimensions or engine ratings. Source revisions report 37.5 hp in the diagram and 38 hp on the product page. CPU, RAM and storage unspecified.

facts.details: Published LOS links: Wi-Fi and broadband radio. OTH links: 4G and Iridium Certus, with traffic management.
Video/IR cameras, lidar and radar feed obstacle avoidance; GNSS and Phins C7 INS support H-8 docking. Quadrans AHRS belongs to the separate deployment system.
250 L fuel tank; approximately 38 hp diesel turns a shaft and fixed-pitch propeller. Datasheet lists 750 W for payloads.
Replaceable submerged gondola accepts mission-selected sonar, inertial or acoustic-positioning instruments; listed payloads are options, not all installed.
CortiX autonomy, web mission planning and third-party APIs; datasheet describes ROS-driven architecture and cloud or edge deployment.

profiles.configuration: May 2021 manufacturer release for the House Zero generation. Not the lighter 2019/2020 printer or newer Titan. Processor, memory, sensor parts, networking and electrical requirements are not disclosed.

facts.details: 9,500 lb gantry-format construction printer extrudes layered wall material; published build capacity reaches 3,000 square feet.
Automated control system operated through an ICON-developed mobile-device application.

profiles.configuration: June 2020 first-hand interview with cofounders David Johnson and Anthony Tayoun. Describes the then-current platform. Processor, arm manufacturer, RAM, storage capacity, RF and electrical supply not specified.

facts.details: A camera at the wrist identifies ingredients and observes the receiving bowl for quality checks.
Preparation video is retained for quality control and learning; storage location and capacity are not established.
Countertop arm switches ordinary kitchen utensils and accepts ingredient/portion orders from the point-of-sale system.
Vision and path planning guide manipulation of variable ingredients. Learning is shared across the fleet; conversational voice control was not available in this interview.

profiles.configuration: Manufacturer HP30 Mk2 reference. This does not establish that the imported DP3 name is an alias. CPU, memory, RF frequency, battery capacity and sensor SKUs remain unpublished in these sources.

facts.details: Electro-optical and infrared imaging for day/night observation; exact camera modules not listed.
Separate waterproof GCS Mk.2 offers a glove-compatible interface; manufacturer describes C2/CMS interfaces and integration with surface vehicles.
Automatic self-righting supports recovery from an inverted position on the water.
Inflatable, buoyant maritime aircraft; manufacturer lists IP67-equivalent protection and takeoff mass below 2 kg.

profiles.configuration: November 2026 H1-series comparison, 111 kg configuration. Do not mix with older 55 kg H-series marketing. The table does not identify a CPU SKU, radio chipset or battery chemistry; its graphics designation is only 5060. Configuration is subject to revision.

facts.details: 20-core/28-thread CPU with a graphics card listed as 5060; exact CPU and GPU suffix not stated.
32 GB DDR5 and 1 TB solid-state storage.
Wi-Fi and Bluetooth supported; versions, bands and chipsets unspecified.
Six-axis IMU, head and wrist depth cameras, lidar and speech-recognition module.
20 Ah pack; battery swapping or plugged-in use. Adapter: 54.6 V, 10 A. Claimed runtime 4–7 hours depends on use.
Two Ethernet, one HDMI and three USB ports; two 24 V/5 A and two 48 V/5 A outputs. Differential-drive base, dual seven-axis arms, standard two-finger grippers; dexterous hands optional.
Python/C++ SDK, upper/lower-level interfaces, URDF and VR teleoperation support.

profiles.configuration: AI² Robotics / 智平方 hardware manual: standard 135 kg configuration, 22 DOF excluding end effectors. Separate from launch-page counts including hands. Adapter and charging-box ratings differ in the manual; no replacement charger compatibility is inferred. Storage and RF chipset are unspecified.

facts.details: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 64GB.
64 GB module configuration; storage capacity not listed.
RealSense D435 at head, chest and back; D405 at each wrist. Chassis has 2D lidar and RGB-D sensing. Four-microphone linear array.
48 V, 30 Ah; automatic recharging and claimed 4–6 hour runtime. Two-wheel differential drive.
LAN Wi-Fi and an operator-enabled configuration hotspot are documented; no SSID pattern, radio version or model-specific passive identifier established.
Rear USB 3.0, HDMI and RJ45. Seven-axis arms support Ethernet, RS485 and CAN; configurable end-effectors use power and digital I/O. Rear emergency stop arrests arm and chassis motion.
Ubuntu 22.04 LTS; Alpha Brain control platform and Python/C/C++ arm interfaces.

profiles.configuration: Manufacturer product sheet revision 003, May 14, 2026. RAM, storage, radio standards, battery capacity and sensor manufacturers are not specified. Base CPU and AI accelerator are distinct modules.

facts.details: AMD Ryzen 5 7640HS base computer; NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin for AI.
Head/chest RGB-D sensing rated up to 1600×1200 at 120 fps; two wrist RGB-D cameras, front/rear mapping lidar, eight ultrasonic sensors, microphone and speaker.
110 V supply requirement, plugged-in operation supported; claimed three-hour battery runtime, with no capacity stated.
Two seven-axis arms, modular end effectors, four-axis torso and two-axis neck. Each arm rated 4 kg; 0–1.9 m vertical workspace.
Autonomous and VR-teleoperated operation.

profiles.configuration: Mornine manufacturer reference linked to the existing Chery catalog name. No CPU/GPU SKU, RAM, storage, battery or radio specification established. Does not inherit Argos, Mobo or other AiMOGA hardware.

facts.details: Six-microphone array, RGB-D and wide-angle cameras, and 3D lidar.
40 body DOF; custom LLM API and RAG knowledge-base integration.
MoNet 6B mixture-of-experts model deployed on-device; manufacturer also describes cloud/on-device dialogue and lidar-camera navigation.
Chery identifies Mornine as its AiMOGA humanoid service robot.

profiles.configuration: Mornine manufacturer reference linked to the existing Chery catalog name. No CPU/GPU SKU, RAM, storage, battery or radio specification established. Does not inherit Argos, Mobo or other AiMOGA hardware.

facts.details: Six-microphone array, RGB-D and wide-angle cameras, and 3D lidar.
40 body DOF; custom LLM API and RAG knowledge-base integration.
MoNet 6B mixture-of-experts model deployed on-device; manufacturer also describes cloud/on-device dialogue and lidar-camera navigation.
Chery identifies Mornine as its AiMOGA humanoid service robot.

profiles.configuration: ArcMove mobile form factor plus shared ARC architecture document v1.7, October 2026. Shared kiosk sensors and network architecture do not identify the mobile base CPU, navigation sensors, motors, battery or memory capacity. Manufacturer-described controls, not an independent security audit.

facts.details: Microphone, presence camera and touchscreen; speaker provides output. Camera processing is local and produces presence attributes.
Manufacturer states that camera frames and audio buffers are transient on-device; browser sessions reset between visitors. Cloud transcripts persist and voice recording retention is configurable.
Dedicated 4G/5G by default, or customer Wi-Fi. ARC describes outbound HTTPS/WSS with TLS 1.2+; no radio chipset or SSID signature specified.
Kiosk opens allow-listed customer pages directly. ARC cloud separately synchronizes mapped knowledge fields and performs live API retrieval; customer pages do not traverse ARC cloud.
Cloud speech, knowledge and answer services; tenant-scoped device credentials. Remote management uses the kiosk-initiated channel; remote support uses an outbound TLS relay.
Wheeled base carries a screen avatar for indoor greeting, escorting and scheduled roaming.

profiles.configuration: Manufacturer KAGO 5 modular platform. Module features apply only when fitted. CPU, memory, radio hardware, battery capacity and navigation sensor SKUs are not supplied. Three-dimensional space describes movement through buildings, not flight.

facts.details: Interchangeable delivery, security and air-treatment modules; standardized docking rails provide module power and communications.
Security module captures images; Air Fresh module lists human recognition, air-quality monitoring and spatial positioning. Sensor SKUs and base navigation sensors are unspecified.
Coordinated operation with other robots, elevators and turnstiles; remote security observation and reporting with the security module.
Wheeled platform with dynamically adjusted indoor speed, published maximum 2 m/s; battery rating not given.

profiles.configuration: S5.3-specific specification section on the manufacturer page. Excludes older generic S5.2 passages and newer S5.4 Orin configuration. RAM, storage capacity, battery chemistry/capacity and exact radio modules are not established.

facts.details: Embedded processors with NVIDIA Jetson TX2 module; other processors not named.
Six panoramic cameras, optical PTZ with 30× zoom and thermal PTZ. Navigation combines satellite positioning and visual motion control.
Wi-Fi and cellular remote supervision; the S5.3 page describes 4G/5G. Versions, bands and installed modem depend on configuration and are not specified.
Automatic docking and battery charging; manufacturer lists up to 24 km per charge at 4–6 km/h, without a battery capacity.
ONVIF/RTSP integration sends surveillance video and events to external VMS systems.
Scheduled routes, obstacle avoidance, person detection, tracking and fleet operation.

profiles.configuration: Current manufacturer platform page reviewed November 2026. Specifications do not identify an older deployment revision. CPU, memory, camera/radio parts and battery capacity are undisclosed; 16 hours is a manufacturer runtime claim.

facts.details: Battery-powered wheeled platform with claimed 16-hour operation; test duty cycle unspecified.
Published 23 kg payload and 2 m reach; operates existing carts, monitors, scanners and touchscreens.
Custom supervision layer handles recovery while learned policies improve across repeated workflows. The page describes increasing autonomy, not universally unattended operation.

profiles.configuration: Manufacturer legacy OctoChef cooking system page. No processor, arm OEM, memory, radio standard or power rating is named. Cloud linkage and tablet operation do not establish Wi-Fi or Bluetooth hardware.

facts.details: Onboard camera supplies images for assessing takoyaki cooking state; sensor model undisclosed.
Collaborative arm dispenses batter and performs cooking motions; contact detection stops motion. Tablet application adjusts batter and cooking time.
Image-based cooking assessment; accumulated learning can be distributed through the cloud to other locations. App also controls preparation and cleaning.

profiles.configuration: Aurora is a rail inspection system carried by a hyrail truck. This source does not establish autonomous driving. CPU, memory, RF equipment, truck engine and electrical supply are unspecified; do not import Aurora Innovation vehicle components.

facts.details: Cameras and lasers form a 3D track image; GPS associates each crosstie with location and condition data.
Hyrail-truck installation, specified for inspection at up to 42 mph; outputs tie grades, asset inventory and GIS coordinates.
Web viewer provides imagery and tie-location/grade records. Grading and optimized tie-set-out planning use the railroad’s maintenance rules.

profiles.configuration: FrontRunner platform architecture; exact controller CPU, RAM, storage and wireless chipset are not public in this reference. 930E chassis generations and engine options must be checked separately.

facts.details: Onboard controllers follow mine maps; a central controller assigns haul routes. Processor models are undisclosed.
Precision GPS with radar/laser obstacle detection.
Komatsu-developed wireless network links the fleet; this source does not specify bands or modem models.
Loading-tool touchscreen computers show nearby fleet movement and authorize truck positioning and departure.
Onboard route execution, loading coordination and dumping under fleet supervision.
Komatsu identifies the 2026 milestone truck as a 930E-5AT with FrontRunner autonomy.

profiles.configuration: FrontRunner platform architecture; exact controller CPU, RAM, storage and wireless chipset are not public in this reference. 930E chassis generations and engine options must be checked separately.

facts.details: Onboard controllers follow mine maps; a central controller assigns haul routes. Processor models are undisclosed.

Onboard route execution, loading coordination and dumping under fleet supervision.
